title: Exact odd division-polynomial detection
statement: Let F be a characteristic-zero field with decidable equality, and let W be a Weierstrass equation over F with nonzero discriminant. For every odd natural number n ≥ 3, W.preΨ' n has degree (n²−1)/2 and leading coefficient n. For every nonsingular affine point (x,y) of W, multiplication of that point by n is the identity if and only if (W.preΨ' n)(x)=0.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → Odd n → (W.preΨ' n).natDegree = (n ^ 2 - 1) / 2 ∧ (W.preΨ' n).leadingCoeff = (n : F) ∧ ∀ (x y : F) (h : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y), n • WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x y h = 0 ↔ (W.preΨ' n).eval x = 0
